Wie sind wir bei der BaFin mit dieser Lage und den Risi - ken umgegangen, die sich daraus ergaben? Mit welchen Themen haben wir uns 2024 beschäftigt? Und welche Prioritäten haben wir gesetzt? translated_text: 2024 was marked by geopolitical tensions, political uncertainty, and a faltering economic performance in Germany. How did we at BaFin deal with this situation and the risks that arose from it? What issues did we focus on in 2024? And what priorities did we set? You will find answers to these questions in this annual report. The following pages make it clear: Our short summary of the financial year 2024 is included.

original_text: 3.000 Beschäftigten haben sich im vergangenen Jahr auf vielfältige Art und Weise für ein funktionsfähiges, inte - gres und stabiles Finanzsystem eingesetzt, dem Unter - nehmen und Menschen vertrauen können. © BaFin/Matthias SandmannIntensiv haben wir im vergangenen Jahr daran gearbei - tet, unsere aufsichtlichen Anforderungen an Kreditin - stitute proportionaler zu gestalten, um kleine Institute von bürokratischem Aufwand zu entlasten.
translated_text: 3.000 employees have campaigned in various ways over the past year on various levels for a functional, inte - gres and stable financial system that can be trusted and people trust. © BaFin/Matthias SandmannIntensively we've worked this past year to make our supervisory requirements for credit institutions more proportional, to relieve small institutions of bureaucratic burdens.

original_text: Im Novem - ber haben wir eine Aufsichtsmitteilung 	veröffentlicht, 	in der wir aufgezeigt haben, welche Gestaltungsspielräume kleine Kreditinstitute in ihrem Risikomanagement haben. Außerdem haben wir mit dieser Aufsichtsmitteilung Erleichterungen eingeführt. Etwa drei Viertel der deut - schen	Kreditinstitute 	dürften	davon	profitieren. Auch darüber hinaus haben wir uns 2024 dafür einge - setzt, Komplexität in der Regulierung abzubauen und entsprechende Vorschläge an die politischen Entschei - dungsträger übermittelt.
translated_text: In November, we published a supervisory notice in which we demonstrated the flexibility small credit institutions have in their risk management. In addition, we introduced facilitations. Approximately three-quarters of German banks will benefit from these. Furthermore, we have committed ourselves to reducing complexity in regulation and submitted appropriate proposals to the political decision-makers in 2024.

original_text: Wir werden auch der neuen Bundesregierung konkrete Vorschläge machen, wie wir in Deutschland und in Europa Komplexität abbauen und mehr Proportionalität in der Finanzmarktaufsicht und -regulierung erreichen können. In der BaFin selbst hat sich im vergangenen Jahr einiges verändert. Am 1. Januar 2024 übernahm die Mathemati - kerin und Aktuarin Julia Wiens  als Exekutivdirektorin die Leitung der Versicherungs- und Pensionsfondsaufsicht. Im Dezember 2024 haben wir bekanntgegeben , dass Raimund Röseler, Exekutivdirektor Bankenaufsicht, Ende März	2025	in	den	Ruhestand 	tritt.
translated_text: [CONTEXT_BEFORE] on benefit. In addition, we committed ourselves in 2024 to reducing complexity in regulation and have forwarded corresponding proposals to the political decision-makers. [/CONTACT_BACK] [TRANCELATE] We will also make concrete proposals for how we can reduce complexity and achieve more proportionality in financial market supervision and regulation. In BaFin itself, there have been several changes over the past year. On January 1, 2024, Mathematis Wiens took over as Executive Director of the Insurance and Pension Fund Supervision. In December 2024 we announced that Raimund Röseler, Executive Director Banking Supervision, retires at the end of March 2025. His successor, Nikolas Speer, took over on April 1, 2025. The current year 2025 is set to offer some uncertainties for the financial industry. The geopolitical situation seems instabil, and the cooperation with the European Union seems to be falling short. Furthermore, the new government's plans for the reduction in complexity of financial market regulation in Germany and Europe are not being fully implemented. Therefore, we will continue to work to ensure that German and European financial markets benefit from greater proportionality and more transparency in their regulation than ever before.

original_text: Seine	Nachfolge 	hat am	1. April	2025	Nikolas	Speer	angetreten. Auch das aktuelle Jahr 2025 hält einige Unwägbarkei - ten für die Finanzbranche bereit. Die geopolitische Lage scheint instabil, die Konjunktur entwickelt sich weiter schleppend. Gleichzeitig schreitet der digitale Wan - del der Finanzbranche schnell voran. Wir werden weiter dafür arbeiten, dass Bankkundinnen und Bankkunden, Versicherte sowie Anlegerinnen und Anleger dem deut - schen Finanzsystem vertrauen können.
translated_text: His successor, Nikolas Speer, took office on April 1, 2025. The current year 2025 also presents some uncertainties for the financial industry. The geopolitical situation seems unstable, the economy continues to develop sluggishly, and the digital transformation of the financial sector is rapidly approaching. We will continue to work to ensure that bank customers, insurers, and depositors can trust the deut - schen financial system.

translated_text: 2. 6.1 EU Disclosure Regulation BaFin Focus on Non-representative Stich-probe on Implementation of the Disclosure Ordinance In 2024, BAFin conducted a representative sample study on the implementation of the Single Requirements for Transparency Regulation (Sustainable Finance Regulation – SFDR). The result: Often, financial market participants use unilaterally formulated pre-contractual information. This often makes it difficult for investors to understand the ecological, social, or political characteristics or objectives of the financial product. To understand these, investors must first understand the meaning of the terms "financial product" and "transparency" in the context of the regulation.

Die BaFin fordert von Fondsanbietern und anderen Finanzdienstleistern, ESG-Ratings 	nicht	unreflektiert 	zu	übernehmen. BaFin fordert leicht verständliche Produktkategorien Die BaFin forderte  2024, leicht verständliche Produkt - kategorien 	mit	klaren	Kriterien	zu	schaffen, 	die	mit existierenden 	Nachhaltigkeitsdefinitionen 	wie	der	EU-Taxonomie verknüpft sind.
translated_text: In 2024, BaFin called for easily understandable product categories with clear criteria that are linked to existing sustainabilitydefinitions such as the EU taxonomy. In addition, ESG ratings often do not always provide an adequate picture of the sustainability characteristics of a financial product. Therefore, fund providers and other financial service providers should not rely unreflektically on ESG rankings in 2024 and again in 2024. To combat this, it called for easy-to-understand product category designs with clearly defined criteria. The goal of the design was to incorporate current sustainability definitions into the design of future financial products.

translated_text: 2.6.3 Preparation for the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive Im Zuge of the still ongoing implementation of the Corporate Disclosure Regulation (CSRD), BaFin will likely be responsible for the audit of the pre-conformance reports of capital market-oriented emit - tents. Once the legal conditions are complied with, it will take over its supervisory functions. Once the required conditions have been met, it intends to retake responsibility for its audits. The focus in 2024 will be on assessing the accuracy and transparency of the corporate sustainability reporting directive.

translated_text: [CONTEXT_BEFORE] 2024, pursuant to Section 352 paragraph 3 of the Insurance Supervision Act (VAG), a new calculation of the transitional measure for technical retrieval positions (Retrieval transitional – RT) is to be ordered. The RT was introduced in 2016 to facilitate insurance companies the transition to the supervisory regime Solvency II. It allows insurance companies to reduce technical re-equivalences during the transition period until 2032 by a deduction amount that decreases continuously. In most cases, the deduction number was determined as the technical reintegration positions due to the low interest rates under SolVENcy II were significantly higher than under Solvecy I.  [CONTACT_AFTER] With the rising interest rate increase since 2022, the coveragequotas have significantly increased. Therefore, the RT was often not able to be measured in the amount required and could even affect premium rates. Due to this, it was often difficult to estimate the adjusted premium rate. Therefore the RT had to be adjusted to the corresponding inflation rate. With this in mind, the annual adjustments for premium rates since 2022 have generally reversed. Coverage ratios have also risen significantly. Thus, in the case of RT adjustments, the adjustable premium rate usually varies from 2.7 percent to 2.9 percent. The corrections are ongoing and can be requested by insurance companies at all times.

translated_text: 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 Source: BaFin Annual Report 2024 III Market Supervision | 52 III Under certain conditions, an ad-hoc notification for the publication of insider information can be postponed without constituting a violation. This often occurs in protracted processes, i.e., processes in which a certain event is brought about over a specific period. Examples include corporate takeovers or significant contract negotiations. Insider information is also often disclosed in closed-ended contract proceedings. For example, this can be done in corporate merger proceedings, merger notifications, and, in some cases, involving special contracts. In these cases, the postponement is usually delayed until further notice. In many cases, this is necessary for preventing unauthorized releases.
